name: immybot-mcp
description: Every ImmyBot endpoint typed, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers the cross-tenant questions the web UI cannot.

immybot_subdomain.title: IMMYBOT_SUBDOMAIN
immybot_subdomain.description: Your ImmyBot instance subdomain - the "acme" in acme.immy.bot. Required: it derives the OAuth scope, and without it the token request falls back to a scope naming your own app registration and Entra rejects it.

immybot_tenant_id.title: IMMYBOT_TENANT_ID
immybot_tenant_id.description: Directory (tenant) ID of the Microsoft Entra tenant your ImmyBot instance trusts.

immybot_client_id.title: IMMYBOT_CLIENT_ID
immybot_client_id.description: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration. Add that app's Enterprise Application object ID as an admin person in ImmyBot (Show More > People > New > AD External ID).

immybot_client_secret.title: IMMYBOT_CLIENT_SECRET
immybot_client_secret.description: Client secret paired with IMMYBOT_CLIENT_ID, from the Entra app registration.

immybot_base_url.title: ImmyBot API base URL
immybot_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from IMMYBOT_SUBDOMAIN. Set it only to point at a different host.

immybot_token_url.title: OAuth2 token URL
immybot_token_url.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave the prefilled default unless your tenant uses a different token endpoint.

immybot_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
immybot_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on ImmyBot requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

immybot_no_config_write.title: Keep credentials off disk
immybot_no_config_write.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
